description: Extract shared async data fetching patterns from 50+ frontend hooks into a unified `useAsyncData<T>(asyncFn, options)` hook. Current duplication: `isLoading`, `isFetching`, `error`, `data` state management is repeated across `useActivities.ts`, `useWebhookSubscriptions.ts`, `usePortfolioRecommendations.ts` and 47 other hooks. Should support: automatic error handling, configurable retries, request cancellation, stale-while-revalidate patterns, loading states (idle/loading/success/error).
